dashboard.title: Professional profile
dashboard.subtitle: Manage how you appear to customers as an individual professional.

list.title: Available requests
list.subtitle: Service requests from customers that match your categories and service radius. Review one and create a quote to respond.
list.empty: No matching service requests right now. Make sure your professional profile is active, with service categories and a service radius configured.

detail.intro: This is a service request from a customer. Review the details below, then create a quote if you'd like to propose a price for the work.

createQuote.title: Create quote
createQuote.intro: This is a customer's service request. Create a quote describing the work and materials you propose, and the price you're offering to complete it.

list.title: My jobs
list.subtitle: Work created from quotes your customers have accepted.

list.title: My appointments
list.subtitle: Appointments from quotes your customers have accepted.
list.emptyDescription: Appointments appear here once a customer accepts one of your quotes.

list.title: My invoices
list.subtitle: Self-billed invoices MaestroYa has issued to you.
list.emptyDescription: An invoice is drafted automatically once a completed job's payment is released to you — this requires an active self-billing authorization.

detail.title: Invoice
detail.acceptIntro: MaestroYa has drafted this self-billed invoice on your behalf. Review the details below and accept it to confirm they are correct.
detail.documentReference: Document reference: {reference}… (tamper-evidence checksum only — not an electronic signature).

selfBilling.title: Self-billing authorization
selfBilling.subtitle: Control whether MaestroYa may issue self-billed invoices to you on completed jobs.
selfBilling.activeDescription: You have authorized MaestroYa to issue self-billed invoices (“facturación por el destinatario”) on your behalf for completed jobs. You can revoke this at any time.
selfBilling.inactiveDescription: Without this authorization, MaestroYa cannot issue self-billed invoices on your behalf, and self-billed invoices cannot be drafted for your completed jobs.
selfBilling.previouslyRevokedDescription: You revoked this authorization previously. You can grant it again below.

verification.title: Verification
verification.subtitle: Verify your identity to earn a “Verified professional” badge on your public profile.
verification.noProfile: You need a professional profile before you can request verification. <link>Create your professional profile</link>.
verification.notStarted: You have not started a verification request yet.

DRAFT.label: Not submitted
DRAFT.description: Upload at least one identity document (national ID, passport or driver's licence) and any supporting documents, then submit for review.

PENDING.label: Pending review
PENDING.description: Your request is in the review queue. We'll let you know once a reviewer has looked at it.

UNDER_REVIEW.label: Under review
UNDER_REVIEW.description: A reviewer is currently checking your documents. No action is needed from you right now.

APPROVED.label: Approved
APPROVED.description: You are a verified professional. A verified badge appears on your public profile.

REJECTED.label: Rejected
REJECTED.description: Your request was not approved. See the reason below — you can address it and resubmit.

RESUBMISSION_REQUIRED.label: Resubmission required
RESUBMISSION_REQUIRED.description: A reviewer needs you to update your request. Follow the instructions below, then resubmit.

verification.fileLabel: File (JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, max {maxMb, number}MB)
